- .github/workflows/implement.yml:939-1108,1846-1910 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The autofix introduced out-of-scope success-no-op / Guard 0 logic and related baseline tracking in `implement.yml`.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers flagged this as substantial scope creep unrelated to the PR’s stated read-only reviewer fix; one reviewer noted the added logic can also prematurely close issues if it misfires.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1103 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The success-no-op regex can match negated or otherwise unintended phrases and short-circuit incorrectly.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the substring-based `grep -qEi` pattern is too broad and can falsely treat outputs like “not already implemented” as success.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:969 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `RUNTIME_DIR` is used unguarded when removing `codex_success_noop.flag`.
  WHY: If `RUNTIME_DIR` is empty or unset, the cleanup path can resolve unexpectedly and risk deleting the wrong file.
- scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh:240 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The summarizer still runs with `--full-auto` before the editor snapshot.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this pre-editor Codex invocation can write to the workspace and contaminate the baseline, recreating the `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` false positive.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:295,523 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge still runs with `--full-auto` in pre-editor phases.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed these invocations can write before the editor snapshot and contaminate the baseline, causing the same `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` false positive.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1060-1090 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The baseline subtraction using `grep -vxFf` is fragile to output-format variation.
  WHY: Reviewers said exact fixed-string filtering may fail if porcelain output differs in whitespace or formatting, causing false positives or negatives.
- scripts/review_consolidate.sh:73 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `review_consolidate.sh` still uses `--full-auto`.
  WHY: The reviewer called this a safe hardening issue because the script can still write to the workspace even if it runs after the pre-editor snapshot.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1103 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Regex pattern for success-no-op detection can match negative phrases like "not already implemented" due to case-insensitive substring matching without word boundaries.
  WHY: Could cause false positive success-no-op detection, closing issues that actually need work.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1060-1090 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `git status` baseline subtraction uses `grep -vxFf` for exact line matching which is fragile to output format variations.
  WHY: If git status output format varies (whitespace, quoting, etc.), the filtering may fail to remove baseline artifacts, causing false positives or false negatives.
- scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh:240 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Summarizer still uses `--full-auto`, allowing workspace writes during consensus phase before editor snapshot.
  WHY: Could write to workspace and contaminate the pre-editor baseline, causing the same `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` false positive the PR is meant to fix.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:295 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Review-blocked judge still uses `--full-auto`, allowing workspace writes before editor snapshot.
  WHY: Could write to workspace and contaminate the pre-editor baseline, causing the same `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` false positive.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh:104 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Use of `--full-auto` instead of `--sandbox read-only` in the summariser.
  WHY: The summariser runs during the review phase before the editor's baseline snapshot. If the summariser writes to the workspace, those changes will land in the editor's baseline, and a subsequent legitimate edit by the editor to the same file will be suppressed, triggering an `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` false positive—the exact bug this PR aims to fix.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:295 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Use of `--full-auto` instead of `--sandbox read-only` in the review-blocked judge's assessment phase.
  WHY: Like the summariser, the judge's assessment phase runs before the editor's baseline snapshot. Any unintended workspace writes by the judge will contaminate the baseline and cause the same `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` false positive.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:939-1108 and 1846-1910 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Substantial scope creep (new success-no-op and baseline logic).
  WHY: While not a logic bug per se, this is "unattended scope creep" introduced by an AI editor. The logic adds significant complexity unrelated to the original read-only sandbox fix.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1103 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Overly broad regex for success-no-op detection.
  WHY: The regex uses substring matching and case-insensitive search across many common words. If a model's output contains a phrase like "the work is not already done" or "more changes are needed," it will still match and falsely trigger the success-no-op short-circuit.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:969 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Unguarded use of `RUNTIME_DIR`.
  WHY: If `RUNTIME_DIR` is empty or unset, the `rm -f` command can resolve to `/codex_success_noop.flag`. While the `-f` flag prevents it from failing, it's unsafe path handling that can lead to unintended deletions in certain environments.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

  WHY: This means text like "not already implemented" would match because "already implemented" is a substring.

  PROBLEM: `rm -f "${RUNTIME_DIR}/codex_success_noop. flag"` runs before any validation of RUNTIME_DIR.
  WHY: If RUNTIME_DIR is empty or unset, this resolves to `rm -f "/codex_success_no op. flag"`, potentially deleting an unintended file in the root directory.
- .github/workflows/implement. yml:939-1108,1846-1910 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The last run introduced substantial new functionality (success-no-op detection with Guard 0) that is unrelated to the original PR intent of fixing EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST by switching to read-only sandbox.
  WHY: The feature adds major workflow logic and tests for behavior outside the PR’s requested scope.
